mapper.insert: INSERT INTO uploaded_asset (asset_id, owner_id, content_key, media_type, size_bytes, created_at) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{ownerId}, #{contentKey}, #{mediaType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT asset_id, owner_id, content_key, media_type, size_bytes, created_at FROM uploaded_asset WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
